edges: Lady Wishfort wants Millamant to marry her nephew, Sir Wilfull Witwoud.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Fainall blackmails Lady Wishfort using information about Mrs. Fainall's affair with Mirabell.
Fainall overhears Mrs. Fainall discussing the plan with Foible.
Mirabell is free to marry Millamant with the full £6000 inheritance.
Lady Wishfort is encouraged by Foible to marry the supposed Sir Rowland.
Mrs. Fainall tells Mirabell that she hates her husband.
Mirabell is free to marry Millamant with the full £6000 inheritance.
Sir Rowland is actually Waitwell in disguise, planning to marry Lady Wishfort.
Foible encourages Lady Wishfort to marry Sir Rowland.
